# pumpfun-rust-client

> Rust SDK for the pump and pump_amm Solana programs: instruction builders, quoting and transaction building for bonding curve and AMM trades.

pumpfun-rust-client is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-rust-client/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
- [Quickstart: buy](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-rust-client/blob/HEAD/README.md#quickstart-buy)
- [Quoting](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-rust-client/blob/HEAD/README.md#quoting)
- [Instruction reference](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-rust-client/blob/HEAD/README.md#instruction-reference)
- [Building, signing, and sending: AsyncPumpClient](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-rust-client/blob/HEAD/README.md#building-signing-and-sending-asyncpumpclient)
- [Account initialization](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-rust-client/blob/HEAD/README.md#account-initialization)
- [Synthetic migration: v3 buys past the curve](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-rust-client/blob/HEAD/README.md#synthetic-migration-v3-buys-past-the-curve)
- [AMM pricing: signed virtualquotereserves](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-rust-client/blob/HEAD/README.md#amm-pricing-signed-virtualquotereserves)
- [Examples](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-rust-client/blob/HEAD/README.md#examples)
